newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan steel firms to fight wire/bar steel dumping.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan steel firms to fight wire/bar steel dumping.

text.p: Three Taiwan steel firms said on Friday they were preparing to file a dumping complaint against major steel makers in six countries and would ask the government to impose anti-dumping tariffs on the firms' products.

Taiwan's China Steel, Feng Hsin and Yieh Hsing are gathering evidence on eight steel firms suspected of dumping steel wire rod and bar in Taiwan, Feng Hsin sales manager Tom Lin told Reuters on Friday.

The companies suspected of dumping include Britain's British Steel, Japan's Sumikin. Lin declined to name the other six steel firms -- one from Poland and South Africa, and two firms each in the Czech Republic and Russia.
Lin said the Taiwan firms had collected concrete evidence and they would file complaints to Taiwan's Finance Ministry in the next few months.
